    AI Overview
    Collin Morikawa withdrew from The Players Championship in March 2026 due to a sudden back injury, specifically described as a back spasm felt during a practice swing on the 11th tee during the first round. He described it as a recurring, severe issue that made it impossible to swing through, forcing his withdrawal. 
    Key Details on Morikawa's Injury: 
    • Injury Type: Back injury/spasms, triggered during a practice swing on the 11th tee at TPC Sawgrass.
    • Impact on Schedule: He withdrew from The Players Championship (March 2026) and later the Valero Texas Open to recover.
    • Masters Status (April 2026): Morikawa returned for the 2026 Masters, stating he was "taking it day by day" and that while the injury did not worsen, he had to manage residual effects and mental hurdles.
    • Recovery: He indicated he underwent MRIs and focused on rest and rehab to ensure the injury did not create further, long-term setbacks.
